squid_hostname.description: Hostname of the Squid proxy server to scrape metrics from.

squid_port.description: Port of the Squid proxy server to read metrics from.

listen_address.description: Address and Port to bind exporter, in host:port format.

metrics_path.description: Metrics path to expose prometheus metrics.

squid_login.description: Login to squid service if required.

squid_password.description: Password to squid service if required.

squid_pidfile.description: Optional path to the squid PID file for additional metrics.

extra_args.description: Any additional arguments to pass to the exporter.
